div.style: color: rgb(13, 33, 61) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Yahoo Finance (yahoo-finance2)
• Quote real-time intraday (chunk 100)
• OHLCV candle 1 bulan - 3 tahun
• Fundamental + rasio valuasi (quoteSummary)
• Laporan keuangan tahunan 2018+ (timeSeries)
• Profil perusahaan dan direksi (assetProfile)
• Makro global: ^JKSE ^VIX ^TNX ^IRX
DXY GC=F (emas) CL=F (minyak)

div.style: color: rgb(13, 33, 61) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Google News RSS Indonesia
• Berita emiten: saham {KODE} / {KODE}.JK
• Berita makro: IHSG, bursa efek indonesia
• Penerbit lokal: CNBC, Kontan, Bisnis.com
• Judul, tanggal, link artikel

div.style: color: rgb(13, 33, 61) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

• Ticker, nama PT, sektor IDX-IC, industri
• Papan Utama / Pengembangan / Akselerasi
• Tanggal IPO

div.style: color: rgb(78, 39, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
⏱ TtlCache in-memory
quote 30 dtk • histori 5 mnt • berita 5 mnt
makro 10 mnt • fundamental 6 jam

div.style: color: rgb(26, 0, 51) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
1. Data Ingestion Agent
Tarik, validasi, bersihkan data mentah;
cek kesegaran timestamp
→ status ok / degraded / failed

div.style: color: rgb(26, 0, 51) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
2. Technical Trend Agent
SMA20/50/200, golden-death cross, RSI-14,
MACD dinormalisasi ATR, ROC, OBV, Z-score
volume, volatilitas, jarak 52-minggu
→ skor S_tech [-1..+1], confidence

div.style: color: rgb(26, 0, 51) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
3. Fundamental Value Agent
PER PBV EV/EBITDA FCF Yield (35%),
ROE margin DER current ratio (42%),
growth (23%), aturan khusus emiten bank
→ skor S_fund + Murah/Wajar/Mahal

div.style: color: rgb(26, 0, 51) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
4. Macro Regime Agent
VIX, inversi kurva 10Y-3M, tekanan DXY,
posisi IHSG vs SMA200/SMA50
→ rezim risk_on / neutral / risk_off
(modifier bobot trading dan investasi)

div.style: color: rgb(26, 0, 51) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
5. News and Sentiment Agent
Leksikon bilingual 45+ kata positif/negatif,
deteksi event (dividen, pkpu, akuisisi),
recency decay half-life 72 jam, LLM
→ skor S_sent + daftar event material

div.style: color: rgb(26, 0, 51) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
6. Quant Momentum Agent
Volatilitas annualized, proksi Sharpe,
ADV 20 hari, historical drawdown
→ tolak saham tidak likuid
(anti saham gorengan)

div.style: color: rgb(0, 51, 42) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
8. Portfolio Synthesizer and Risk Guardian
• Sintesis: bobot dinamis per horizon+rezim,
skor konsensus, agreement, P_up
• Risk: SL 2xATR, TP 2R, Fractional Kelly ¼
6 kendala: risiko 1% / vol 15% / plafon 20%
/ 1% ADV / sektor 35% / kill switch DD 15%

div.style: color: rgb(74, 0, 32) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
7. Contrarian Critic Agent
Auditor adversarial / red-team: cek 13 aturan
deterministik (data, konflik teknikal vs
fundamental, overbought, risk-off buy, dll)
→ vonis pass / caution / reject + HAK VETO

div.style: color: rgb(27, 52, 9) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
📌 Keputusan final per emiten:
strong_buy / buy / hold / reduce / sell
Rencana Entry - StopLoss - TakeProfit (Rp),
jumlah lot, nilai alokasi modal
